# Mone Agency | Elite Model Management

Mone Agency is a premier South African modeling agency providing elite model management, scouting, and portfolio development. Based in Sandton (Gauteng), Cape Town (Western Cape), and Pietermaritzburg (KZN), we represent high-fashion talent for global and local campaigns.

## Core Services
- Model Management: Professional representation for high-fashion models.
- Scouting: Discovering new talent across South Africa's fashion hubs.
- Portfolio Development: Natural digital "polaroid" capture and professional portfolio building.

## Strategic Hubs
- Sandton (Diamond District): Elite business and fashion representation in Gauteng.
- Cape Town (V&A Waterfront Precinct): High-fashion scouting and campaign management in the Western Cape.
- Pietermaritzburg: Cultural and regional talent development in KZN.

## Application Requirements
Aspiring models can apply directly via our portal.
- Required Data: Height (cm), Age, Bust/Waist/Hips, Shoe Size, Instagram handle.
- Digitals: Max 10 natural photos, < 2MB each.
